item.title: Southern University's band to honor Michael Jackson
item.description: With worldwide anticipation of the release of “MICHAEL,” the Southern University “Human Jukebox” Marching Band, along with two other HBCU bands, are joining forces to honor the legacy of Michael Jackson in celebration of Black History Month.

item.title: Crawfish prices drop for second straight week during Lent
item.description: Crawfish prices in South Louisiana are dropping for the second week, providing relief to consumers during Lent. Find out more about the decrease.

item.title: Southern University board to discuss granting 2 posthumous degrees
item.description: Southern University board members are set to discuss granting posthumous degrees to two students who died last year.

item.description: A Zachary man is set to serve 180 months in federal prison after being convicted on drug charges.

item.title: Man accused of 2022 deadly shooting in Baton Rouge pleads guilty
item.description: A man who was accused of a deadly shooting at a 2022 party pleaded guilty in February.

item.title: Deputy Energy Secretary visits Iberville Parish for opening of $700M power plant
item.description: Federal, state, and local leaders gathered in Plaquemine Thursday to celebrate the opening of a major new power facility expected to strengthen Louisiana’s electric grid and help stabilize energy costs.

item.title: Baton Rouge community unites for Lincoln Theatre renovation fundraiser
item.description: The Lincoln Theatre is scheduled to reopen this summer following a recent fundraising event held to cover renovation costs. Organizers offered seats for $500 each during the event to help reach funding goals for the facility.

item.title: Pay raise proposed for Southern University band director as program grows
item.description: A salary increase is proposed for Dr. Kedric Taylor, the director of bands at Southern University.
